propositions: Four workflows (test.yml, optionality.yml, prompt-eval.yml, verify-identity.yml) must append 'tickets' to their on.push.branches-ignore lists to prevent push events on the tickets branch from triggering CI runs.

A new enumerating test must verify that no workflow file in .github/workflows/ matches a push to the tickets branch, and the test must read the directory from disk rather than hardcoding workflow names to catch future regressions.
Documentation must warn adopters that rebar's auto-push on every write can trigger CI for any monitored branch, recommending schedule-based alternatives instead of branch-filtered push events.
All schedule cron expressions across edited workflows must remain byte-identical to pre-change values, and gerrit-verify.yaml must remain workflow_dispatch-only.
Push CI for ordinary topic branches must continue to match and fire on the edited workflows after the change.
